acceptanceCriteria: Built-in profiles cover the user-approved version 1 instrument list.
Users can create, rename, duplicate, reorder, and delete profiles and their notes.
Profiles support arbitrary practical note counts rather than assuming six strings.
Versioned persistence survives relaunch and rejects or repairs invalid values safely.
rationale: The product must serve a multi-instrument musician without hard-coded instrument assumptions.
testSteps: Test profile validation, ordering, CRUD operations, round-trip persistence, and migration.

workItem.title: Build tuning profiles and local persistence
